content: Yesu iurpe tomtom matapisŋana ta
Yesu iwwa ma ila na, ire tomtom matapisŋana ta. Ni ta kembeiŋana mi naana ipeebi.
Mi naŋgaŋ kini tiwi i ma tiso: “Mos katuunu, uunu ki asiŋ ta tomtom ti mataana ipis ma isu? Uunu imbot la ni itunu sanaana kini, som tamaana ma naana sanaana kizin?”

Yesu ipekel kwon ma iso: “Uunu ta tomtom ti mataana ipis imbot la ni itunu sanaana kini som, mi tamaana ma naana sanaana kizin som. Pataŋana ta ipet pini, inabe iwe zaala pa Anutu ma iswe mburaana mi uraata kini ma tomtom tire kat.

Iŋgi kembei aigule. Pa nio aŋbotmbot toono mi aŋurur mat pizin tomtom toono kan. Tana zoŋ mataana iyaryaara ta kembei, mi takam uraata ki Ni ta iŋgo yo ma aŋmar i pataaŋa. Pa molo som to mbeŋ imar. Tona tomtom sa ko irao ikam uraata mini som.”
Yesu iso sua tana makiŋ to, iro su pa ululu ma ise nama keteene, mi ikiziu kauziini ise, mi ipaŋoneŋ. To imoono la tomtom tana mataana,

mi iso pini: “La ma ŋguuru motom sula yok tatiliuŋana Siloam.” (Zaana Siloam ka uunu ta kembei: ‘Ŋgoŋana’) Beso tomtom tana ileŋ la Yesu kalŋaana, mi ila ma iŋguuru mataana na, mataana ikam pak mi ire lele. To imiili ma ila ruumu kini.
Tana wal pakan ki kar tina, ziŋan tomtom pakan ta muŋgu tire tomtom tana izuŋzuŋ le koroŋ na, timaŋga ma tiso: “Wai, tomtom ta muŋgu imbutultul mi izuŋzuŋ le koroŋ, ta itunu ti?”
Mi pakan tiso: “E! Ni tau.” Mi pakan tiso: “E-e, ni som. Iŋgi ko tomtom toro. Mi ko ruŋgun raraate ma iŋgi.” To ni itunu imaŋga mi iso: “Som. Iŋgi nio tau.”
Tabe zin tiwi i ma tiso: “So mbulu i ta ipet pu, ta kam ma motom ipeere mi re lele na?”

Ni ipekel kwon ma iso: “Tomtom ta zaana Yesu, ni ipaŋoneŋ ululu ma imoono ila motoŋ, mi iso pio be aŋla aŋguuru motoŋ sula yok tatiliuŋana Siloam. Tana aŋto kalŋaana na, loŋa men mi motoŋ ikam pak ma aŋre lele.”
To zin tiwi i mini ma tiso: “Mi tomtom tana ila parei?” Mi ni iso: “Ii, nio aŋute i?”
Zin tutu kan titiiri uraata ki Yesu
To tikam tomtom tana ma tila kizin wal tutu kan.
Pa aigule ta Yesu ikam uraata pa mataana na, aigule potomŋana kizin be keten su.
Tana zin tutu kan tomini tiwi i ma tiso: “Nu motom ipeere be parei?” Mi ni iso pizin: “Ni ikam tiiŋgi ma imoono la motoŋ, mi aŋla aŋguuru motoŋ, to motoŋ ikam pak.”

Tana tutu kan pakan tiso: “Tomtom tana, ni Anutu iŋgo i som. Pa ni itoto aigule potomŋana ka tutu som.” Mi pakan tiso: “Soom. Kozobe ni tomtom sananŋana, so irao itooro mos biibi ta kembena?” Tana tiparbalak zin.
To tiwi tomtom ta Yesu iurpe i na mini ma tiso: “Nu ta iurpe u ma motom ambai na, kam ŋgar pini be parei?” Ni ipekel kwon ma iso: “Ni Anutu kwoono.”
Ŋonoono, tomtom tana naana ipeebi na, mata pisŋana. Mi buri, ni mataana ipeere. Tamen zin bibip kizin Yuda tiurla som. Tana tiboobo tamaana ma naana ma timar,
mi tiwi zin. Tiso: “Tomtom ti, iŋgi lutuyom ŋonoono? Parei, indeeŋe ta kepeebi ma isu na, ni mataana ipis, som som? Mi parei ta buri mataana ipeere ma ire lele?”
Mi tamaana ma naana tiso: “Tomtom ti, iŋgi niam lutuyam. Ni isu raama mataana ipis.
Tamen uunu tau mataana ipeere pa i, mi asiŋ ta ikam mbulu tana pini, ina niam amkankaana pa. Ni naŋgaŋ? Mi kena kiwi i. To itunu iso.”

Zin tiso ta kembei paso, timoto zin bibip kizin Yuda. Pa zin timbuk sua kek ta kembei: Tomtom sa isombe iurla kembei Yesu ni Mesia, inako tiziiri i pa lupŋana kizin ma imbot mat. Irao igaaba zin pa suŋŋana ma koroŋ mini som.
Uunu tana, ta tamaana ma naana tiso: “Ni naŋgaŋ? Kena kiwi i.”
Tana tiso la pa tomtom tana ma imar kizin mini, mi tiso pini. Tiso: “Kozo so kat sua ŋonoono piam ila Anutu mataana. Niam ti amute: To tana, ni tomtom sananŋana.”

Mi ni ipekel kwon ma isombe: “Ni tomtom sananŋana, som tomtom ambaiŋana, ina leŋ sua sa pa koroŋ tana som. Mi koroŋ tamen ta nio aŋute kat na ta kembei: Muŋgu motoŋ ipis. Mi buri taiŋgi motoŋ ipeere ma aŋre lele.”
Tana tiwi i mini ma tiso: “Ni ikam parei pu? Ni ipeere motom be parei?”
To ni ipekel kwon ma iso: “Wai, sua ta aŋso ma keleŋ kek. Tamen niom kakan la kalŋoŋ som. Uunu parei ta konoknok wiŋana? Kenako niom tomini leleyom be kewe naŋgaŋ kini?”
Tabe zin keten malmal, mi tigiibi sua repiiliŋana pini ma tiso: “Nu ta we to tana naŋgaŋ kini. Mi niam na, ki Mose.
Pa niam amute: Mose, ni ikam kat sua ila Anutu kwoono. Mi to tana na, amkankaana pini. Ni iwwa le parei ta imar ipet i.”
Tabe tomtom ta muŋgu mataana ipis na, ipekel kwon ma iso: “Waai! Tomtom tana ipeere motoŋ. Mi iŋgi kusu mini mi koso kakankaana pini? Niom tina ko leyom ŋgar? Motoyom mar.
Iti tuute: Anutu, ni irao be ileŋ la zin wal sananŋan kalŋan na som. Ni ileŋleŋ zin wal ta timototo i mi tileŋleŋ la kalŋaana.
Ta muŋgu muŋgu mi imar na, teleŋ tomtom sa uruunu pa mos ta kembei i som.
Tomtom taiŋgi, sombe ni imar pa Anutu som, so irao be ikam uraata biibi sa ta kembei na som.”
Sua kini tana ipas kat keten. Tabe tigiibi sua pini ma tiso: “Ai nu tina na, nom ipeebu ma su raama sanaana! Mi nu sombe paute yam?” Tiso pini ta kembena, to tiziiri i pa lupŋana kizin ma imbot mat.
Wal ta matan munŋan pa mbulu ki Anutu
Yesu ileŋ tomtom tana uruunu kembei tiziiri i pa lupŋana kizin, to ila na indeeŋi mi iwi i. Iso: “Parei? Nu lelem iurla ki Tomtom Lutuunu, som som?”
Mi ni ipekel kwoono ma iso: “Biibi, Tomtom Lutuunu tana, ni asiŋ? So yo pini bekena aŋurla kini.”
To Yesu iso: “Nu re i kek. Nio ta ituru tozzo sua i.”
Tana tomtom tina iso: “Merere, nio aŋurla ku.” Mi ilek kumbuunu pini mi ipakuri.
To Yesu iso: “Marŋana tio, inabe iswe zin tomtom. Pa nio aŋsu toono ti bekena zin wal tau matan munŋan na, matan ipeere. Mi zin tau tisombe matan peereŋan, nako matan imun.”
Yesu izzo sua tana na, zin tutu kan pakan timbotmbot kolouŋana pini ma tileŋi. Tana tiso pini: “Parei, nu so niam ti motoyam munŋoyam?”
Mi Yesu iso pizin ma iso: “Kozobe motoyom munŋoyom, so leyom uunu sa som. Tamen niom koso motoyom peereŋoyom mi kombot mat kek. Tanata iwe uunu piom ma kombotmbot raama sanaana tiom.”
